name: Add a repository permission
description: Add a repository permission Grant a team access to a VCR repository. POST /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/permissions
context:
POST /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/permissions
Grant a team access to a VCR repository. Sharing applies to the whole repository.
Required: projectId (query) — Project ID or name (slug) within the authenticated team. IDs take precedence over names. Missing or empty values return HTTP 400.; idOrName (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Clear all repository permissions
description: Clear all repository permissions Revoke every team's access to a VCR repository. DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/permissions/all
context:
DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/permissions/all
Revoke every team's access to a VCR repository. Clearing an unshared repository is a no-op.
Required: projectId (query) — Project ID or name (slug) within the authenticated team. IDs take precedence over names. Missing or empty values return HTTP 400.; idOrName (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Delete a repository
description: Delete a repository Schedule a repository for deletion. DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}
context:
DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}
Schedule a repository for deletion. The repository is marked so it disappears from list/get immediately; subscriber-vcr reclaims every image (manifests, blobs, tags and rows) and finally deletes the repository row asynchronously via the VcrRepositoryRemoved event.
Required: projectId (query) — Project ID or name (slug) within the authenticated team. IDs take precedence over names. Missing or empty values return HTTP 400.; idOrName (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Delete a repository image
description: Delete a repository image Schedule an image for deletion. DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageId}
context:
DELETE /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageId}
Schedule an image for deletion. The image is marked so it disappears from list/get immediately; subscriber-vcr reclaims the manifest, blobs, tags and row asynchronously via the VcrManifestRemoved event.
Required: projectId (query) — Project ID or name (slug) within the authenticated team. IDs take precedence over names. Missing or empty values return HTTP 400.; idOrName (path); imageId (path)
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Get a repository image
description: Get a repository image Fetch an individual image from a repository, including its tags and Dockerfile history entries with discriminated layer details for UI rendering. GET /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageIdOrDigest}
context:
GET /v1/vcr/repository/{idOrName}/images/{imageIdOrDigest}
Fetch an individual image from a repository, including its tags and Dockerfile history entries with discriminated layer details for UI rendering. The image may be addressed by its internal id (`image_...`) or by its manifest digest (`sha256:...`).
Required: projectId (query) — Project ID or name (slug) within the authenticated team. IDs take precedence over names. Missing or empty values return HTTP 400.; idOrName (path); imageIdOrDigest (path) — The internal image id (`image_...`) or the image manifest digest (`sha256:...`).
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
